procedural_matters: Based on SI 15.6, boats intending to request a hearing or request redress for an incident in the racing area shall radio their intention to the Race Committee, which NED 447 did.
NED 447 was represented by Arne Hubregtse
GER 1171 was represented by George Skolaut.
Tonny Jensen gave evidence as a member of the international jury.
Hearing No. 7 was heard together with hearing No. 8 in accordance with RRS 63.2(b) since both hearings arose from the same incident.
During the hearing the protest committee clarified in accordance with RRS 63.2(c) that the hearing request was not only a request for redress but also a protest, and proceeded with it accordingly.
NED 447 provided evidence by showing pictures of the damage on the mobile phone.
facts: Wind 10-12 knots and waves less than 0.5 meters.
NED 447 was sailing on starboard tack on a close-hauled course.
GER 1171 was sailing on port tack on a close-hauled-course on a converging course with NED 447.
Two other boats were on port tack on a closed-hauled course to leeward of GER 1171. Both boats bore away and passed behind NED 447.
When NED 447 was a hull length away from GER 1171, both crews established sight of each other. At that time the bow of GER 1171 was pointing midships to NED 447.
When GER 1171 was half a hull length away from NED 447, she sharply bore away.
GER 1171 caused contact with its bow and the last metre of the starboard side of NED 447 getting with its bow on top of the deck of NED 447.
The rudderstock was cracked in its connection on the deck and the starboard runner was broken/out of the deck of NED 447.
NED 447 retired within one minute after the incident.
conclusions: GER 1171 on port tack failed to keep clear of NED 447 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
GER 1171 did not avoid contact with NED 447 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
It was not reasonably possible for NED 447, the right-of-way boat, to avoid contact with GER 1171 when it became clear that GER 1171 was not keeping clear. NED 447 did not break RRS 14(a).
Since GER 1171 caused serious damage by her breach, her penalty was to retire as required by RRS 44.1(b).
NED 447’s place in race 3 was made significantly worse through no fault of her own by physical damage because of the action of GER 1171 that was breaking RRS 10 and 14(a) and was penalized.
decision: Redress is given to NED 447. NED 447 is to be scored in race 3 points equal to the average, rounded to the nearest tenth of a point (0.05 to be rounded upward), of her points in all races sailed before the last scheduled day of the regatta. No other boat’s score shall change.
